title: Chapter 10 — Endorsements
description: The imam, the pastor and the unions all have votes in their pockets. Each one wants something for theirs.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Friday. The central mosque. Imam Sule has received three candidates this week. All three promised a borehole. None of them knew where the mosque's well was.

beats.speaker: imamSule
beats.text: Teacher. My congregation is two thousand voters. I don't tell them how to vote. (He pauses.) I just tell them who visited.

beats.speaker: imamSule
beats.text: He is waiting for your promise.

options.text: "Show me the well. If it's broken, the council fixes it, for everyone, not for votes."
Donate ₦30,000 to the mosque's Ramadan feeding.
"I respect the mosque too much to bargain in it."

beats.objective: Sunday: the Redeemed Light church at the Front Stop.

beats.speaker: pastorFemi
beats.text: (after service, in his office, which has a better chair than Baba Oko's) Teacher! God has shown me you will win. (Pause.) God has also shown me the church needs the land behind the motor park. For a crusade ground.

beats.speaker: pastorFemi
beats.text: The land behind the motor park is where the danfo drivers park at night.

options.text: "That land belongs to the drivers. I can't give it to you, Pastor."
"After the election, Pastor. Let's pray about it."
Ask him to pray for all the candidates, publicly.

beats.speaker: babaTicket
beats.text: (on the phone, an hour later) Teacher. Somebody told me you promised our parking ground to Pastor Femi. Tell me that somebody is a liar.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Monday. The okada riders' union, the market women, the road transport workers, all in one room at the motor park. Endorsement day.

beats.speaker: mamaTiti
beats.text: We will announce together. Whoever we endorse wins this ward. (She looks around the room.) So, Teacher. Convince the room.

perfect.toast: Three unions, one voice: "TEACHER!" Somebody beats a drum on a plastic chair.

beats.speaker: babaTicket
beats.text: (standing up) The drivers endorse him. On one condition: the parking ground stays ours. Say it in front of everybody, Teacher.

beats.speaker: babaTicket
beats.text: Pastor Femi's deacon is in the room, writing.

options.text: "We will find a solution for everybody."

beats.title: Endorsements
beats.summary: The mosque, the church and the unions all weighed you. Some of the promises you made this week will outlive the election.
